title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under peer influence, information campaigns, policy mandates, enforcement, costs, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence_update
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use among their network neighbors and adjust attitudes/behavior via social learning or threshold rules.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_event
interactions.description: At locations or in public spaces, non-compliant individuals may be warned or fined based on enforcement probability and location strength.

interactions.name: purchase_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks given availability, price, and their purchase propensity and inventory level.

interactions.name: media_broadcast_and_exposure
interactions.description: Media outlets disseminate messages that affect risk perception, trust, and attitudes; individuals update beliefs based on reach and bias.

interactions.name: location_entry_and_compliance_check
interactions.description: Individuals visiting locations are checked for mask use if a policy applies; enforcement may change behavior.

interactions.name: contact_event_transmission
interactions.description: Optional disease sub-model: contacts at locations may transmit infection with probability modified by mask efficacy and compliance.

interactions.name: household_norm_transmission
interactions.description: Within households, attitudes and behaviors are shared, accelerating convergence to common mask norms.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until 50% of the population adopts mask use.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate during the simulation.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_after_policy_lift
metrics.description: Average adoption maintained for 30 days after mandate removal.

metrics.name: average_compliance_by_location_type
metrics.description: Mean observed compliance in workplaces, schools, retail, transit, etc.

metrics.name: inequality_index_by_group
metrics.description: Disparities in adoption across demographic or income groups (e.g., Gini or Theil index).

metrics.name: masks_sold
metrics.description: Cumulative number of masks sold by retailers.

metrics.name: cases_or_Rt_reduction
metrics.description: If disease sub-model is active, reduction in infections or effective reproduction number attributable to adoption.

validation_criteria.name: target_adoption_under_mandate
validation_criteria.description: Under strong mandate parameters, simulated adoption reaches at least 80% by day 45.

validation_criteria.name: steady_state_convergence
validation_criteria.description: Adoption change per day falls below 0.1% for 30 consecutive days.

validation_criteria.name: logistic_fit_quality
validation_criteria.description: Adoption curve fits a logistic model with R^2 >= 0.9 during initial diffusion phase.

validation_criteria.name: policy_monotonicity_check
validation_criteria.description: Increasing enforcement_probability should not reduce mean adoption across 90% of random seeds.

validation_criteria.name: calibration_rmse_threshold
validation_criteria.description: If calibrated to observed adoption data, RMSE between simulated and observed adoption <= 0.05.
